notes.title: Update 1.5.0
notes.notes:
note: this update was released on a wednesday because it was my friend's birthday

SUMMER CHANGES
Because summer is basically here (at least where I am), I've decided to change some things to fit the times!


Removed egg projectile and replaced them with beach balls
    
    The beach balls will bounce around for 5 seconds after hitting something other than an enemy, so watch out!
    Removed egg piles and replaced them with beach ball piles
The ground on most snowball fight maps is sand


HORDES

Added a home base
https://i.ibb.co/NNckY7h/Capture.png
Added a map and difficulty selector
    
    Select between difficulties: easy, normal, and hard (high difficulty = more XP and tokens)
    Added upgrades:
    
    Increase chicken health (max 500)
    Increase snowball damage (max 300)
    Increase move speed (max 30)
    Progression
    
    XP - requires 3000 to level up, and leveling up rewards you with 300 tokens
    


SNOWBALL FIGHT

Changed map #3 so that there are 4 new platforms to play on
Changed map #5 (blue map) so that it feels more smooth to jump around when sprinting. I also added a few staircases
Removed hitboxes on the edges of the roads on map #4 in snowball fight
Made Katana hitbox larger
Katana swings faster with a shorter cooldown
Katana equips faster
Changed fast-fall key bind to match crouching key bind
Decreased respawn time to around 1.5 seconds
Added ambient noise (it's just wind)
Added a Katana kill sound
New weapon: Charge Pistol
    
    Holding down the RMB will charge the pistol and shoot a larger bullet
    Cost: 75 coal for 12x ammo
    Changed practice range (more dummies & platforms)
Added a kill counter
Monkey Launcher now counts for coal and kills respectively
https://i.ibb.co/2SprNBy/Capture-1.png


STEAM INTEGRATION

Added 2 Achievements (they're jokes)
    
    "Top G" - Open the game
    "Bottom G" - Close the game
    
https://i.ibb.co/HPwsTm9/Capture.png


OTHER CHANGES

Some graphical changes
New hat cosmetic: Smiley Face
    
    Cost: 1000 snowbucks
    Added VSync

notes.title: Update 1.4.0 - The 'Game Mode' Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Today I'm releasing a chunky update that adds a bunch of new stuff.

Technical change: upgraded to Unity's Universal Render Pipeline

NAME CHANGE
As you can tell, I decided to change the game's name from 'Feisty Festivities' to 'Winfray'. The name 'Winfray' stems for 2 words, wintry and fray. I decided to change the name because I feel as if the name 'Feisty Festivities' only fits for the Christmas season, which may lead people away from checking out the game. I also feel as if the name doesn't feel very "exciting" if that makes sense.

NEW GAME MODES
2 new game modes called 'Hordes' and 'Minigames' have been added and are available to play. When you first launch up the game, you'll be greeted to a new menu where you can select between Snowball Fight, Minigames, and Hordes.

MINIGAMES
Choose from a list of minigames where you can earn coal. Currently, the only one available to play is 'Falling Crates' where you dodge falling crates for a long as possible. The longer you stay alive, the more the crate spawn rate increases. For every second you survive, you'll earn 1 coal, but I might change this. If you have any suggestions or ideas for games, please let me know in the discord server.

HORDES
Endlessly defend the giant chicken from being touched by hordes of enemies. Before starting, you're given options that you can change. These options include the time between each enemy spawning, the maximum amount of enemies allowed at once, and if you want the enemies to be more difficult.

Note: My goal with this game mode is to make it a full on game. I want to make it so you can complete quests, level up, and upgrade yourself while playing on different maps.

SNOWBALL FIGHT
It's Easter! To fit to the times, I've made some Easter-related additions that you may appreciate have have also added/changed some stuff that hopefully make the game more fun!

Cosmetics
    
    You can now change the appearance of your characters with all-new cosmetics! The cosmetics include the colour of your player and hats!
    Hats unlocked with new currency: Snowbucks
    Leveling removed and replaced with Snowbucks
    Snowbucks earned from killing players (like coal), but you receive less
    
Weapon System Changes
    
    Removed the current weapon system and replaced it with an ammo-based one.
    Added a quick-buy menu that can be opened by pressing 'Q' that buys ammo for the gun you want
    Ammo does not get reset when you die
    Monkey Launcher price reduced to 50 coal
    
New weapon: katana
    
    Melee weapon - doesn't require ammo
    
New movement mechanic: fast fall
    
    When in the air, you can hold down 'V' to fall quicker to the ground
    
2 new maps
Added practice/firing range
Added the ability to upgrade how many snowballs you can hold at once with coal
Changed blood splash particle effect
Changed kill sound (ITS MORE MEATY)
Weapons you hold now get displayed to other players
Added a camera shake when you throw snowballs
Changed snowball pickup sound
Most maps now have snow falling particles
Snowballs now look like eggs
Snowball piles now look like egg piles


I hope that this update makes the game a little more fun because there are more things to do. If you have any ideas for game modes or changes, feel free to join the discord and let me know!

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.notes:
Small patch including bug fixes and some tweaks:


Fixed a bug that exploits respawning & coal (hopefully).
Reduced price for monkey launcher to 100 coal.
Increased XP gained from kill.
Increased XP requirement to level up to 700.
Increased coal gained from kill.
Fixed an issue with level not displaying after increasing.


Next update should also have randomized spawn points to prevent spawn camping. So for now, just don't be cringe and spawn camp.

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
NEWLY ADDED

Added crouching (more info deeper in patch notes).
Added a monkey launcher (more info deeper in patch notes).
Replaced the large map with 4 smaller fps maps.

CHANGES & QUALITY OF LIFE

Changed main menu background.
Changed death particle.
Made some tweaks to the UI.
When in the pause menu, your player's camera now locks from moving.
Changed the player model's texture.
Increased the angle in which you can look down before you can no longer shoot.
Removed stamina.

CROUCHING INFO

You can toggle crouching by pressing either 'left-control', 'left-shift', or 'C'.
Speed is decreased when crouched.
Footstep audio is removed when crouched.
Footstep particles are removed when crouched.
Shooting/throwing is disabled when crouched.
Added animations for when crouching.
Hitbox decreased when crouched.
Jumping when crouched un-crouches you instead of letting you jump right away.

MONKEY LAUNCHER INFO

Can be purchased with 300 coal by pressing 'Q'.
Does AOE damage, killing anyone within a set radius (15, but idk the units cuz unity weird).
Shoots monkey (obviously).
Monkey explodes into bananas.
Does not grant you coal (might change).

Small patch coming soon to re-add snow particle and snow chunks on the maps so it doesn't look like you're picking up snowballs from grass, as well as adding the ability to see what weapon other player's have equipped.
